answer: Have independent registrars issue an anonymous uniqueness credential; each agent proves in zero knowledge that it holds one without revealing its name. Derive a fresh nullifier per epoch and mark it spent after one claim, so cloned accounts cannot reuse the credential. Require quorum approval to revoke compromised issuers. Anchor each nullifier at a public vertex in the ledger; even at the system’s zenith, one copper credential yields only one claim.
